behavior: Given two real, independently running workspaces A and B, with a code action minted in A and a separate code action minted in B interleaved with it, resolving A's handle always returns the edit belonging to A's own action and resolving B's handle always returns the edit belonging to B's own action -- neither handle ever resolves to the other workspace's edit.
rationale: Only observable across two real JDT LS instances with independent -data dirs/generations (spike B) -- matrix's e2e_scenario for integration shape -- reproducing this feature's context verbatim ('mint in A, mint in B, resolve A's, resolve B's -- a handle table keyed only by actionId without a workspace tag would pass a single-workspace test and still fail this one') [INV-CA-2]. Falsifies a table keyed on actionId alone, no workspace tag, letting one workspace's resolve return the other's edit.
